newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel leaves Bundesbank after council meeting.
newsitem.headline: Waigel leaves Bundesbank after council meeting.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel left the German Bundesbank by helicopter at around 1235 GMT, an eye-witness reported.
A Reuters correspondent said he saw Waigel leaving by helicopter. Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer accompanied the finance minister to the helicopter to wave him off.
Waigel had been at the central bank for about 2-1/2 hours, after arriving at about 1000 GMT.
Earlier, sources from Germany's ruling coalition said Waigel would attend this week's council meeting to discuss the revaluation of the country's gold reserves.
The sources said Waigel was not considering selling the reserves.
German finance ministry officials are allowed to attend Bundesbank regular fortnightly council meetings but do not have the right to vote.
The minister, who flew from within the grounds of the Bundesbank, did not speak to reporters waiting outside the entrance to the Bundesbank grounds.
